title: A Solvency II-Based Framework for Pricing Structural Longevity Risk under an Affine Mortality Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.26670v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a Solvency II-based pricing framework for structural longevity risk in incomplete longevity markets. The valuation scheme relies on the Cost-of-Capital principle underlying the Risk Margin and combines it with a continuous-time affine mortality model. Mortality dynamics are specified in calendar time, with age-dependent mortality patterns linked to a latent longevity factor driving long-term mortality improvements. The affine structure preserves closed-form survival probabilities and provides a tractable basis for repeated Best Estimate, Solvency Capital Requirement and Risk Margin calculations. We derive the conditional distribution of one-year discounted Best Estimate variations, obtaining analytical expressions for their asymmetry and Value-at-Risk under the Gaussian affine specification. translated_title: 基于偿付能力II（Solvency II）的仿射死亡率模型下结构性长寿风险定价框架
translated_abstract: 本文开发了一个基于偿付能力II的定价框架，用于在不完全长寿市场中为结构性长寿风险定价。该估值方案依赖于风险边际背后的资本成本原则，并将其与连续时间仿射死亡率模型相结合。死亡率动态以日历时间设定，年龄相关的死亡率模式与驱动长期死亡率改善的潜在长寿因子相关联。仿射结构保留了生存概率的闭式解，为反复计算最优估计、偿付能力资本要求和风险边际提供了易于处理的基础。我们推导了一年期贴现最优估计变化的条件分布，在高斯仿射设定下获得了其不对称性和风险价值（Value-at-Risk）的解析表达式。在此框架下，我们引入了一种基于压力的评估方法，通过对控制……的确定性参数施加不利冲击（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一个将偿付能力II资本成本原则与连续时间仿射死亡率模型相结合的结构性长寿风险定价框架，能够解析推导最优估计变化的不对称性与风险价值，并可通过不利冲击实现压力评估。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a Solvency II-based framework for pricing structural longevity risk by combining the Cost-of-Capital principle with a continuous-time affine mortality model, deriving analytical expressions for the asymmetry and Value-at-Risk of Best Estimate variations and enabling stress-based assessments via adverse shocks.
